# Module: `icescopy_inptk_plot`

Supplies axes, legends, and draggable temperature controls for INP plots.

[Source](../src/icescopy_inptk_plot.py) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

Keeps plot geometry and mouse handling separate from the analysis window. Temperature tags map between screen positions and the plot axis and emit edits for the panel to apply. Axis limits depend on the displayed quantity and finite values; these helpers do not calculate concentrations.

## Classes

| Class | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [`_FixedLegend`](API-Class--FixedLegend.md) | Prevents the plot legend from being moved by dragging. |
| [`PlotLegend`](API-Class-PlotLegend.md) | Places a compact, scrollable legend at the top right of the plot viewport. |
| [`TemperatureTags`](API-Class-TemperatureTags.md) | Draws and drags the active sample's temperature tags below the plot. |
| [`ConcentrationAxis`](API-Class-ConcentrationAxis.md) | Formats concentration ticks on a logarithmic plot axis. |
| [`TemperatureRangeItem`](API-Class-TemperatureRangeItem.md) | Allows temperature-boundary dragging while leaving the region interior available for plot navigation. |
